productDefinition: AI Council is a local-first senior technical decision and execution operating layer for builders. It composes project and conversation context, validates intent, plans evidence, formulates the real problem, compares strategies, coordinates specialist judgment, governs consequential actions, verifies results, and preserves decision memory while the repository remains the source of truth.
productCategory: AI-assisted technical decision, reasoning, and governed execution operating system for builders
productStage: Cognitive Foundation V1 plus Problem Formulation and Strategy Comparison V1 are merged; Cognitive Critic, confidence calibration, intent verification, routing-intelligence authority, broader execution, and full product-surface migration remain downstream work.
problem: AI-assisted builders can move quickly across models and coding tools while losing project context, problem quality, evidence discipline, alternative strategies, hard constraints, dissent, provenance, safe execution boundaries, and continuity. AI Council is intended to make technical work earn the right to become action instead of turning the latest model answer into an unreviewed decision.
primaryUsers: technical solo founders building serious software with AI assistance
senior engineers using multiple AI coding and reasoning tools
product-minded developers managing several evolving software projects
primaryJobs: recover the real project and conversation context before acting
separate the surface request from the underlying technical problem
compare defensible strategies against evidence, constraints, cost, reversibility, and invalidation conditions
surface dissent, uncertainty, missing evidence, and hard boundaries before commitment
turn an accepted decision into a governed action and verify the result
preserve decision lineage so future sessions know what was decided, why, and with what authority
secondaryJobs: run repeatable technical workflows and evaluations
coreWorkflow: compose project collective memory and conversation continuity
understand the task and validate intent, goal, constraints, ambiguity, and privacy boundaries
formulate the problem while preserving causal uncertainty and solution-anchoring safeguards
generate and compare strategies against sourced decision criteria, hard constraints, prerequisites, and invalidation conditions
coordinate specialist analysis, challenge, synthesis, and preserved dissent where consequence justifies it
make or withhold a decision based on evidence and confidence
cross explicit governance and human-approval boundaries before consequential action
execute only permitted work, verify the outcome, and record trace, rollback, and memory evidence
primaryActions: inspect the interpreted goal and evidence state
challenge or refine the formulated problem
compare strategy candidates and rejection reasons
inspect evidence, assumptions, constraints, dissent, and confidence
verify the outcome and resume later from decision memory
valueProposition: Give AI-assisted builders a reviewable path from ambiguous intent to defensible technical action: project-aware reasoning that makes evidence, alternatives, constraints, uncertainty, human authority, execution, verification, and memory lineage visible instead of hiding them behind a confident chat answer.
differentiators: The value is trusted technical judgment plus safe execution, not agent quantity.
Semantic correctness, decision correctness, and execution correctness are separate targets with routing deliberately downstream of understanding and formulation.
Problem causes remain hypotheses, deterministic alternatives remain visible, and model-supplied strategy attributes are treated as claims rather than self-awarded scores.
Hard constraints and unresolved prerequisites are non-tradeable; weighted preference cannot rescue an ineligible strategy.
Conversation continuity and project memory have authority, freshness, provenance, and promotion rules rather than treating chat history as truth.
Consequential reasoning does not silently become mutation; approval, validation, reversibility, and trace are explicit product mechanics.
alternatives: manual combinations of ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, GitHub, and project documentation
productMechanics: Project memory and thread continuity are composed before semantic understanding.
Validated intent and an Evidence Plan precede Problem Formulation.
Problem Formulation preserves hard constraints, symptoms, causal hypotheses, alternatives, and unresolved evidence rather than accepting the user's first causal story as fact.
Strategy Comparison preserves deterministic anchor strategies, validates model-claimed effort, cost, reversibility, and kind, and exposes candidate-specific prerequisites and invalidation conditions.
Decision criteria retain source, sourceRef, confidence, hard-versus-soft authority, and all operation-specific success criteria.
Specialist reasoning and provider output remain advisory to deterministic safety and evidence boundaries.
Governed execution requires permission and approval state, constrained targets and commands, rollback metadata, validation, and an execution report.
Memory promotion requires evidence or confirmation; model output cannot become canonical project truth merely because it is confident.
Provider failure or timeout can fall back to deterministic baselines instead of fabricating intelligence.
intelligenceModel: Models are replaceable reasoning engines operating over repository and project truth. AI Council owns context composition, semantic validation, evidence planning, problem formulation, strategy comparison, specialist coordination, governance, execution boundaries, validation, trace, and memory. Stronger models may enrich reasoning but cannot weaken protected constraints or compensate for a wrongly understood problem.
trustModel: Trust comes from being able to inspect what the system believed the goal was, which evidence was available or missing, which assumptions and causal hypotheses remain unproven, which strategies were considered and rejected, which constraints were hard, where dissent remained, what required approval, what actually executed, what validation passed, and what was recorded into memory. Confidence is one signal, never authority by itself.
riskModel: The system fails if it optimizes the wrong problem, lets a persuasive model erase deterministic alternatives or hard constraints, converts missing evidence into false certainty, implies routing or execution authority that is not yet shipped, hides dissent, executes without approval, leaks private context, overstates validation, or promotes unverified reasoning into project truth.
governanceModel: Human authority remains at consequential boundaries. Hard privacy, approval, forbidden-action, scope, and preservation constraints are explicit and non-tradeable. Routing remains downstream and is not yet controlled by the new cognitive chain. Non-dry-run action is intentionally narrow and auditable, with approval, safe targets, validation, rollback, and evidence-bearing memory promotion.
desiredPerception: A calm, precise, technically formidable senior partner that makes difficult technical decisions legible and accountable: rigorous without compliance theater, collaborative without swarm theater, modern without AI magic, and visibly human-directed as consequence rises.
undesiredPerception: agent swarm where quantity implies intelligence
autonomous AI magic that hides uncertainty
another terminal skin presented as technical credibility
nonNegotiables: Do not visually imply uncontrolled autonomy; human authority and governance are real mechanics.
Do not reduce the product to agent portraits, node count, or a literal council room.
Do not represent project memory as generic chat history; authority, freshness, provenance, and decision lineage matter.
Do not hide rejected strategies, dissent, assumptions, hard constraints, or missing evidence merely to simplify the interface.
Do not imply routing, execution, validation, or end-to-end-loop maturity beyond what current AI Council main actually ships.
Treat problem formulation, evidence, decision criteria, approval, reversibility, verification, and memory lineage as first-class product material.
constraints: Problem Formulation and Strategy Comparison V1 are implemented, but they do not yet own council, provider, tool, or execution routing authority.
Cognitive Critic, Confidence Calibration, Intent Verification, and broader Cognitive Reliability evaluation remain deferred.
The normal Web /ask experience is not yet fully migrated onto the cognitive runtime.
The governed action runtime intentionally executes only a narrow low-risk slice.
Current shipped behavior and architecture intent must remain visually distinguishable.
categoryConventions: terminal and monospace styling as shorthand for technicality
glowing orb or central AI brain metaphors
mission-control grids centered on simultaneous agent activity
categoryCliches: black background with neon blue, purple, and cyan glow
floating connected nodes as shorthand for intelligence
AI headshots around a virtual council table

matrix or terminal aesthetics detached from product meaning
animated reasoning particles that conceal rather than explain decision state
opportunitiesToBreakConvention: Make the path from ambiguous intent to a defensible decision the primary experience rather than the agents themselves.
Treat a technical decision as a durable artifact with inspectable evidence, alternatives, constraints, dissent, approval, execution consequence, verification, and memory lineage.
Use rejected strategies, invalidation conditions, evidence strength, provenance, and unresolved uncertainty as compositional material.
Express governance through thresholds, boundaries, pauses, reversibility, and proof rather than security-dashboard chrome.
Treat project memory as a living decision record rather than a transcript archive.
Create technical seriousness through editorial, spatial, or archival craft instead of terminal aesthetics.
unknowns: Which user segment should dominate the first commercial product experience: solo founder, senior engineer, or small technical team?
What narrow promise should become the first sellable end-to-end loop?
Which cognitive stages should be directly manipulable in the product UI versus mostly background orchestration?
How much internal architecture should remain visible to users once the decision workflow becomes simpler?
How should confidence be communicated without turning a score into false authority?
assumptions: Local-first and privacy-conscious behavior remains strategically important.
AI Council remains focused on technical and product-building decisions before broadening to generic business decision software.
The brand north star Orchestrated Intelligence remains active, but the draft violet-blue-cyan interface palette is not mandatory for every Creative World.

authorship.agent: AI Studio OS Product Understanding V1 dogfood

evidence.claim: AI Council defines itself as a senior technical operating system for builders whose value is trusted technical judgment plus safe execution, with the repository as source of truth.

The current cognitive sequence is Project Collective Memory through Conversation Continuity, Task Understanding, validated Intent/Goal, Evidence Planning, Problem Formulation, and Strategy Comparison, while routing and execution authority remain downstream.
AI Council separates semantic correctness, decision correctness, and execution correctness and makes routing downstream of understanding, evidence, formulation, and comparison.

Problem Formulation preserves hard constraints, causal uncertainty, alternatives, and evidence gaps; Strategy Comparison preserves deterministic anchors, validates model claims, gates prerequisites, and treats hard criteria as non-tradeable.

The product brand is Orchestrated Intelligence and should expose context, evidence quality, uncertainty, approval, validation, ledger, and memory while avoiding magical, theatrical, swarm-like behavior.
The identity brief rejects generic chatbot, magical AI sparkle, random agent swarm, crypto-token, neural-network poster, and glow-dependent technical aesthetics.
Consequential action remains bounded by explicit governance, approval, constrained execution, validation, and trace rather than model autonomy.
